538.title: The "save or leave" question always shows in front of every popup, panel and menu
humanItems: At 390 px (Chrome device mode, iPhone 12 Pro) and at 1280 px: on `/recipe-book`, tap the round "+" button, pick "הוסף מתכון עם AI", type "בדיקה" in the box, then press Escape (phone: tap the dark area outside the popup). The question "יש שינויים שלא נשמרו. האם אתה בטוח שברצונך לצאת?" shows **in front of** the AI popup and its buttons react; "ביטול" returns to the popup with "בדיקה" still typed.

At 390 px and 1280 px: on `/recipe-builder`, type a new name in the "תחנה" field and pick the add line at the bottom of the list; in the "הוסף תחנה חדשה" popup change the text, then press Escape (phone: tap outside). The question shows in front of the popup.

At 390 px only: on `/inventory/equipment`, open any row for editing, change its name, then tap the dark area outside the panel. The question shows in front of the panel, not under it; "יציאה בלי לשמור" closes the panel.
At 1280 px: on `/inventory/add`, type a product name, then click "לוח בקרה" in the header. The question shows in front, with "יציאה בלי לשמור" (no change from today — a regression check).

539.title: The toast fits a phone screen: 16 px side gaps, long text wraps, clear of the notch
humanItems: At 390 px (Chrome device mode, iPhone 12 Pro): on `/suppliers/add`, paste `ספקירקותופירותטריים_בעמ_מרכז_הארץ_סניף_ראשי_מספר_אחת` as the supplier name and save. The toast `הספק "…" נוסף בהצלחה` (shows 2 seconds) is fully on screen with an even gap on both sides, the name wraps onto more lines, nothing is cut. Afterwards delete that test supplier.

At 390 px: open any product from `/inventory/list`, tap the red bin on one purchase-option line. The toast "השורה הוסרה" with the button "בטל" (stays 30 seconds) is fully on screen; tapping "בטל" brings the line back. Leave with "יציאה בלי לשמור".
At 1280 px: repeat the supplier save. The toast sits in the top-left corner about as wide as before, the long name wraps inside it.
